relations.subject: Adelheid Mette
relations.evidence: Adelheid Mette studied Classical Philology in Hamburg where she prepared a PhD on the Aiolian meters in the dramas of Euripides (1959).

relations.subject: Adelheid Mette
relations.evidence: From 1972 to 1988 she was first Hochschulassistent (Assistant Professor), then Professor (1980) at the University of Munich.
